title: Ghost Murmur quantum sensor detects a soldier's heartbeat

tellings.quote: And he was I think he needed to be rescued and they detected his heartbeat via this quantum sensing modality.

plain: A quantum sensor called Ghost Murmur, meaning a detector that uses quantum physics to pick up extremely faint signals, is said to have found a soldier who needed rescuing somewhere in the Middle East, perhaps Iran or Afghanistan, by detecting his heartbeat. Michels tells this himself, hedging with "I think", and connects it to Lockheed Martin. He offers it as a sign of how far secret sensing technology has advanced.
